Jace, measured

Values come from the custom properties in jace.ai's stylesheet, resolved on 2026-11-18. Light applies html.light so the published :root:where(.light) overrides win. Dark is bare :root, the theme app.jace.ai/signin paints. The marketing site itself does not add .light. It paints cream pages with Tailwind utilities, Geist Sans and Gelica. The toggle sets data-mode on the document.

Colour

Product roles. Sand, lemon, ember and deepsea are the brand ramps. The marketing ink is #2d2d2d.

Type

Marketing display is Gelica at 88px on the hero. Product UI is Inter Variable. Geist Sans is the marketing body face.
